entry.name: Spiritbound Marksman

feature.name: Spellcasting
feature.description: Spells channeled through objects, cast with Wisdom; prepares Wisdom modifier + half its level.

feature.name: Spiritfire Gun
feature.description: A spirit-imbued firearm: a ranged spell attack with Wisdom, 1d10 force a shot; 2 shots at 5th level, 3 at 11th, 4 at 17th.

feature.name: Tools of the Trade
feature.description: Gunsmith's tools and one artisan's tool.

feature.name: Lesser Echo Marks
feature.description:
Once a turn, before firing, one mark: Agonizing Echo (Wisdom modifier on each shot), Binding Shot or Grasping Shot.

Not simulated: Binding Shot (speed −10 ft) and Grasping Shot (pulled 10 ft on a failed Strength save): Agonizing Echo is always the one used.

feature.name: Harmonized Echo
feature.description: Enhances non-magical objects for an hour: light, a compass to a creature it hit, silence, a reroll.

feature.name: Greater Echo Marks
feature.description: More marks: Warding Ember (+2 AC on a hit until its next turn), Spiritbrand Shot (tracking), Recoil Step (10 ft without opportunity attacks after firing).

feature.name: Echo-Forged Arsenal
feature.description: A second gun of another path, swapped on a rest.

feature.name: Spiritual Circuitry
feature.description: One Lesser Echo Mark is always active, beside the turn's chosen mark.

feature.name: Echoforge Imprint
feature.description: An hour's ritual binds a trap or ward to an object or place.

feature.name: Echo-Forged Arsenal Upgrade
feature.description: A third gun.

feature.name: Avatar of the Forgotten
feature.description:
Once a long rest, a minute in Spiritform: resistance to all damage but force and psychic, and 1d10 more force damage a shot.

Not simulated: ignoring difficult terrain and moving through others' spaces.

feature.name: Echoforged Apex
feature.description:
Gun shots crit on a 19 or 20; two Echo Marks at once; two guns at hand.

Not simulated: the second mark and the second gun.

startingEquipment.label: A light crossbow, a dagger and studded leather

entry.description: A gunslinger bound to spirits: a Wisdom spell-gun that fires more shots as it grows, echo marks, and a path that shapes the gun.

entry.name: Path of the Deadeye
entry.description: A six-shooter for precise, controlled fire, and brands that make a target easier for everyone to kill.

feature.name: Six-Shooter
feature.description: The gun is a six-shooter: range 60/120 ft.

feature.name: Death's Brand
feature.description: Once a turn, a shot that hits brands the target: the next creature to hit it before the marksman's next turn deals 1d6 more necrotic damage.

feature.name: Mark of the Last Breath
feature.description:
Death's Brand lasts until the end of the marksman's next turn and deals 2d6 necrotic.

Not simulated: branding a second creature once a long rest.

feature.name: Bullet Beyond Death
feature.description:
Once a long rest, a missed shot is rolled again with advantage.

Not simulated: moving the brand to another creature within 60 ft when the branded one dies.

entry.name: Path of the Silent Veil
entry.description: A long spirit rifle for stealth and assassination.

feature.name: Spirit Rifle
feature.description: The gun is a spirit rifle: range 120/300 ft.

feature.name: Silent Requiem
feature.description: Shots make no sound or flash, so firing from hiding needn't give the marksman away.

feature.name: Whisper in the Fog
feature.description:
Wisdom on Stealth while hidden, harder to spot after firing from beyond 60 ft, and Invisibility on itself once a short rest.

Not simulated: the Stealth and Perception parts.

feature.name: Fade into the Mists
feature.description: A reaction when a creature ends its turn within 15 ft: teleport 30 ft and be heavily obscured until its next turn (Wisdom modifier times a long rest).

entry.name: Path of the Bayou Blight
entry.description: A scattergun for close-range blasts that leave foes open to force.

feature.name: Scattergun
feature.description: The gun is a scattergun: range 30/90 ft.

feature.name: Shatterpulse Round
feature.description: On a hit, creatures within 5 ft of the target make a Dexterity save or take 1d6 force; all of the attack's shots go at one target.

feature.name: Swampburst Shards
feature.description:
Once a turn, a hit makes the creature save (Constitution) or be vulnerable to force damage until the end of the marksman's next turn.

Not simulated: that the creature must be within 10 ft.

feature.name: Spiritual Backblast
feature.description: Shatterpulse Round can push everyone it hits 10 ft, or give the marksman 10 temporary hit points and a free 10 ft move.

entry.name: Arcane Trickster
entry.description: A rogue who adds wizard spells to sneaking and stabbing. Third caster: Intelligence, the wizard's list.

feature.name: Spellcasting
feature.description: Wizard spells cast with Intelligence, slots as a third caster; Mage Hand always known.

feature.name: Mage Hand Legerdemain
feature.description: The spectral hand is invisible and can pick pockets, stow objects and work locks and traps.

feature.name: Magical Ambush
feature.description: While invisible, a creature saving against the trickster's spell does so with disadvantage that turn.

feature.name: Versatile Trickster
feature.description: A Trip from Cunning Strike can also topple a creature beside the spectral hand.

feature.name: Spell Thief
feature.description: As a reaction to a spell aimed at it, the trickster can try to steal the spell, negating it and keeping it for 8 hours.

entry.name: Path of the Zealot
entry.description: A barbarian whose rage is a god's fury: radiant damage, divine healing, and allies made bold.

feature.name: Divine Fury
feature.description: While raging, the first creature it hits each turn with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike takes 1d6 + half its Barbarian level more radiant damage.

feature.name: Warrior of the Gods
feature.description:
A pool of d12s (4, growing to 7): as a bonus action, spend dice and heal the total rolled.

Not simulated: spending more than two dice at once.

feature.name: Fanatical Focus
feature.description:
Once per rage, a failed save can be rerolled, adding its Rage Damage bonus.

Not simulated: it's once a fight, raging or not.

feature.name: Zealous Presence
feature.description:
A bonus action battle cry: up to ten other creatures within 60 ft have advantage on attack rolls and saves until its next turn. Once a long rest.

Not simulated: getting it back by spending a Rage use.

feature.name: Rage of the Gods
feature.description:
Raging, it can take a divine warrior's form for a minute: a fly speed, and resistance to necrotic, psychic and radiant damage.

Not simulated: Revivification (a reaction spending a Rage use to keep a creature within 30 ft above 0 hit points).

entry.name: Path of the Totem Warrior
entry.description: A barbarian guided by an animal spirit: the bear's toughness, the eagle's sight, the wolf's pack.

feature.name: Spirit Seeker
feature.description: Beast Sense and Speak with Animals as rituals.

options.name: Bear
options.description: Resistance to all damage but psychic while raging.

feature.name: Totem Spirit: Bear
feature.description: While raging, resistance to every damage type but psychic.

options.name: Eagle
options.description: Hard to pin down while raging.

feature.name: Totem Spirit: Eagle
feature.description: While raging, others have disadvantage on opportunity attacks against it, and it can Dash as a bonus action.

options.name: Wolf
options.description: Allies strike true beside it while it rages.

feature.name: Totem Spirit: Wolf
feature.description: While raging, its allies have advantage on melee attacks against hostile creatures within 5 ft of it.

feature.name: Aspect of the Bear
feature.description: Twice the carrying capacity, and advantage on Strength checks to push, pull, lift or break.

feature.name: Aspect of the Eagle
feature.description: Sees far without trouble, and dim light doesn't hinder its Perception.

feature.name: Aspect of the Wolf
feature.description: Tracks at a fast pace, and moves stealthily at a normal pace.

feature.name: Spirit Walker
feature.description: Commune with Nature as a ritual.

feature.name: Totemic Attunement: Bear
feature.description: While raging, hostile creatures within 5 ft have disadvantage on attacks against anyone else.

feature.name: Totemic Attunement: Eagle
feature.description: While raging, it flies at its walking speed (falling if it ends a turn in the air).

feature.name: Totemic Attunement: Wolf
feature.description: While raging, a bonus action knocks a Large or smaller creature it hit with a melee attack prone.
